meta.description: A Grades 6–11 lyceum in Sirdaryo. Eight subject tracks, exam preparation, and help with university applications.

hero.lead: Eight subject tracks. Exam preparation and university applications are handled inside the school. One teacher is responsible for each family.

statement.body: Come to the school: sit in on a lesson, meet the teachers, look at the term reports.
statement.honesty: We don't put rankings or percentages on this site without a document behind them. We'll tell you where our graduates study, and if you ask for the phone numbers of current parents, we'll give them.

academics.title: What grade is your child in?
academics.lead: Choose a grade and we'll show the subject tracks for it. The exam block is chosen with the family from Grade 9.

parliament.title: The Student Parliament
parliament.lead: Five students run school activities for the year: events, volunteering and media. The posts are filled by election.

life.title: Beyond the lesson
life.lead: Sport, subject olympiads, events, trips and volunteering.

alumni.title: Our graduates
alumni.lead: Each graduate takes two minutes to say where they studied and what they do now.
alumni.note: Videos are added with each graduate's permission. If you'd like to speak to one of them, tell us.
alumni.placeholder: We'll publish admission percentages once we can back them with a document.

parents.title: What parents say
parents.lead: Parents of children who study here now. Ask for a phone number and we'll get permission and connect you.

why.lead: You can check each one by visiting the school.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.lead: There are three ways to start.
admissions.l1Body: Watch the graduate videos. Nothing to fill in, nobody calls you.
admissions.l2Body: Message us on Telegram about the fee, the subject blocks, transport or the study-abroad process. We usually reply the same day.
admissions.l3Body: Come on a normal school day. Sit in on a lesson and meet the teachers. Take the entrance assessment if you want to.
admissions.footnote: Before comparing the fee, add up what you paid for tutoring last year.

tagline.label: LEARN GROW LEAD — the school motto
